profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Target
profile.summary: Computer science graduate of University of Minnesota Twin Cities. A software engineer @ Target! Good experience with RESTful APIs, Kafka, fullstack and backend development. Now I'm stepping my toes into the ML/MLOps space!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Data and ML Engineering
- Demand Forecasting 
- API Development and Kafka Streams

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Data and ML Engineering
- Forecasting and Data Pipelines
- Backend development and API work

positions.title: Technology Leadership Program - Software Engineer
positions.description:
Rotation 1: Full stack development with Doppler application, a platform that enables supply planners to create, maintain, and share capacity plans with Target's internal and external partners

Rotation 2: Improved pipeline runtime, GPU usage, and scalability for Monet Outfitting Boards, Target's outfit recommending system that uses computer vision to generate visually complementary outfits. Gained experience working with machine learning models/systems, and python development.

positions.title: DHS Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Analyzing data from informational surveys containing questions targeting men, women, and children’s health.
• Creating and editing Stata files to dissect and evaluate data, sort variables, and create tables for other researchers to use
• Transcribing informational surveys into a clear, HTML format in order to put up onto the research center’s website.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Participating in both front-end and back-end development for the Property Design Team to add more functionality to their website and improve the usability for product users. 
- Used Typescript and React to create a page where users could edit, add, and view information about their project milestones. 
- Designed an API using Java and Spring Boot to interact with the database and display the data results on the UI.
- Practiced CI/CD concepts for deploying our API and UI to ensure code is satisfactory and that users will never have an interrupted experience while using the website. 
- Communicated and collaborated with the team strongly by participating in Agile methodology

positions.title: Teacher
positions.description:
• Mastered and instructed students on a variety of technical and engineering skills, such as robotics and coding.
• Introduced students to new programming and game development software such as Unreal Engine and Unity.
• Taught students important programming concepts such as inheritance, loops, and data types.
